snippet.title: Robot Basketball League Concept Trailer - Dribble, Dunk, and Shoot
snippet.description: The Robot Basketball League game has been in development for several months and will soon be available to wish list on Steam! Here is a brief overview trailer showing what the concept for the game looks like. There will be lots of Single Player offerings, including Tournament and Season Mode. There is also 2-player Local Multiplayer! Game footage not final. Not rated by the ESRB.
